tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background behind every section. Never used for text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, figures, the outline sidebar, controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px borders and dividers on page and surface. Decorative only; never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All prose, headings, chart values and labels, on page and surface (14.97:1 on page).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, source lines, on page and surface (5.96:1 on page, 6.47:1 on surface). Never below 12.5px.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: App bar background.

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Text and control borders on chrome (16.21:1).

tokens.name: chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Breadcrumb and secondary text on chrome (9.05:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Teaching voice, primary action, earned-check fill, the emphasised bars in a figure. As text only on page, surface or primary-bg (5.86:1, 6.36:1, 5.36:1).

tokens.name: primary-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the current outline item, section badges and H chips.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and check glyph on a primary fill (6.36:1).

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Text of work-along callouts, timers and M chips, only on attention-bg (6.34:1).

tokens.name: attention-bg
tokens.usage: Tint of work-along callouts and M chips.

tokens.name: attention-fill
tokens.usage: Solid amber for the work-along marker dot and progress within a callout. Never text, never on white without a label.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Text of defect labels, failure states and L chips, only on caution-bg (5.92:1).

tokens.name: caution-bg
tokens.usage: Tint of caution callouts and L chips.

tokens.name: chart-context
tokens.usage: Bars and marks that are context, not the subject. 2.18:1 on surface by intent: every context mark carries a direct value label in ink.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1. Fixed order, never cycled.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4. A fifth series becomes Other or a second chart.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Practical AI Usage in Daily Advisory Workflows

styles.name: section
styles.sample: Citation Failure Types on the Cole RMD Age
styles.usage: Section opener heading, once per section.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Four failure types, in ascending order of danger

styles.name: finding
styles.sample: Retrieval and linked citations reduce fabrication. They do not make a citation safe to send unread.
styles.usage: The one-sentence finding under a section heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The model samples a plausible answer. It does not compute the true one.
styles.usage: All prose. Measure capped at 64 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Share of legal queries answered with a hallucination
styles.usage: Outline items, captions, source lines, margin notes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, chips, table headers. The smallest size allowed anywhere.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: You are the advisor who attended, writing the file note a colleague will read.
styles.usage: Prompts, model output and code only. Never labels, buttons or captions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph gap; callout padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and figure padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap under a section opener.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, callouts, bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, figures, buttons, outline items.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Round glyphs: earned checks, chip dots.
